description: Source code for an Ogg media extractor implementation in Android, including classes for handling Ogg pages, Vorbis and Opus streams, and integration with Android media framework.

classes.name: OggSource
classes.description: Media track helper class for reading Ogg stream data.

classes.name: MyOggExtractor
classes.description: Base class for Ogg stream extraction, handling page parsing, seeking, and metadata extraction.

classes.name: MyVorbisExtractor
classes.description: Derived class for handling Vorbis-specific Ogg stream extraction.

classes.name: MyOpusExtractor
classes.description: Derived class for handling Opus-specific Ogg stream extraction.

classes.name: StandAloneMediaBuffer
classes.description: Helper class for media buffer during initial header parsing.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the media track for reading.

methods.name: seekToTime
methods.description: Seeks to a specific timestamp in the stream.

methods.name: seekToOffset
methods.description: Seeks to a specific byte offset in the stream.

methods.name: readNextPacket
methods.description: Reads the next Ogg packet, handling page parsing and timestamp calculation.

methods.name: verifyHeader
methods.description: Verifies header packets for Vorbis or Opus streams.

methods.name: getTimeUsOfGranule
methods.description: Converts granule position to timestamp in microseconds.

methods.name: approxBitrate
methods.description: Returns an estimated bitrate of the stream.

methods.name: parseFileMetaData
methods.description: Parses metadata tags from the stream.

methods.name: buildTableOfContents
methods.description: Builds a table of seek points based on page granule positions.

methods.name: setChannelMask
methods.description: Sets audio channel mask based on channel count and metadata.
